episodes.title: The First Meeting
episodes.synopsis: In heavy rain on Colombo Road, Kasun sells homemade short eats and tea from his small three-wheeler, his clothes simple and his eyes full of ambition. Across the road, elegantly dressed Anudi steps out of a family car with an umbrella, walks away, and Kasun watches her leave.

episodes.title: The Difference
episodes.synopsis: Over a few weeks, Anudi visits Kasun's food three-wheeler each evening and they fall in love, until Anudi's Father sees them and confronts her that night. Kasun works day and night and begins supplying three small shops. A major supermarket calls with a huge order, but he needs Rs. 2 million to expand and doesn't have the money.

episodes.title: The Choice
episodes.synopsis: Kasun tries everything, but nobody believes in his small business. Anudi's Father meets him, places a cheque on the table, and Kasun pushes it back and walks away. Later, a large sign reading KASUN'S — SRI LANKAN FOOD & COFFEE is unveiled; Anudi's Father approaches, shakes Kasun's hand, and Anudi smiles as they stand together beneath it.

scenes.heading: EXT. Colombo Road - DAY
scenes.title: Heavy Rain On Colombo Road
script: It rains heavily.

scenes.heading: EXT. Kasun's Food Three-Wheeler - DAY
scenes.title: Kasun Sells As Anudi Arrives
script: Kasun stands beside his small three-wheeler.
He sells homemade short eats to office workers.
He sells tea to office workers.
His clothes are simple.
His eyes are full of ambition.
Kasun: One day… I'll have my own restaurant,
A comfortable family car is across the road.
Anudi steps out of the family car.
She is dressed elegantly.
She holds an umbrella.
She accidentally drops her phone near Kasun's three-wheeler.
Kasun picks up the phone.
He runs after her.
Kasun: Miss! Your phone!
Anudi turns around.
Anudi: Oh… thank you.
She looks at his little business.
Anudi: You made all this yourself?
Kasun smiles.
Kasun: Started with Rs. 5,000. I'm trying to make it bigger.
Anudi smiles back.
Her phone rings.
Anudi's Father: Anudi, where are you? Come home. We need to talk about your marriage.
Her smile disappears.
She looks at Kasun one more time.
Anudi: Maybe… I'll see you again.

scenes.heading: EXT. Colombo Road - DAY
scenes.title: Anudi Walks With Umbrella
script: She walks away.
She holds her umbrella as she goes.

scenes.heading: EXT. Kasun's Food Three-Wheeler - DAY
scenes.title: Kasun Watches Her Leave
script: Kasun watches her leave.

scenes.heading: EXT. Kasun's Food Three-Wheeler - EVENING
scenes.title: Anudi and Kasun Grow Close
script: A few weeks pass.
Anudi starts visiting Kasun's small business every evening.
They talk.
They laugh.
They slowly fall in love.
Anudi's Father sees them together one evening.

scenes.heading: INT. Anudi's Family Home - NIGHT
scenes.title: Anudi's Father Confronts Her
script: That night, he confronts her at home.
Anudi's Father: That boy? He has nothing!
Anudi: He has a dream.
Anudi's Father: Dreams don't build a family. Money does.

scenes.heading: INT. Kasun's Small Workspace - DAY
scenes.title: Kasun Supplies Three Shops
script: Kasun works day and night.
He has started supplying his food to three small shops.

scenes.heading: INT. Kasun's Small Workspace - EVENING
scenes.title: Supermarket Order, Funds Needed
script: One evening, Anudi visits him at his small workspace.
Anudi: Why are you working this hard?
Kasun looks at her.
Kasun: Because I don't want your family to ever say I'm not good enough for you.
Anudi holds his hand.
Anudi: I don't care about your money.
Kasun smiles.
Kasun: But I care.
Suddenly, his phone rings.
A major supermarket chain calls to place a huge order.
Kasun can't believe it.
Then the reality hits him.
He needs Rs. 2 million to expand.
He has nowhere near that amount.

scenes.heading: INT. Kasun's Small Workspace - DAY
scenes.title: Kasun Refuses Anudi's Father's Cheque
script: Kasun tries everything.
Nobody believes in his small business.
Anudi's Father comes to meet Kasun.
Anudi's Father places a cheque on the table.
Anudi's Father: Rs. 2 million.
Anudi's Father: Take it. Build your business.
Kasun: Thank you, sir.
Anudi's Father: There is one condition.
Anudi's Father: Leave my daughter.
Kasun looks down at the cheque.
Kasun slowly pushes the cheque back.
Kasun: Sir… I want your daughter.
Kasun stands up.
Kasun: But I don't want to buy my future with your money.
Kasun walks away.

scenes.heading: EXT. Successful Restaurant - DAY
scenes.title: Handshake Beneath Kasun's Sign
script: A large sign is unveiled.
On screen: KASUN'S — SRI LANKAN FOOD & COFFEE
Anudi's Father watches from a distance.
Anudi's Father walks toward them.
Anudi's Father: I was wrong.
Anudi's Father: You didn't need my money to become successful.
Anudi's Father holds out his hand.
Anudi's Father: You just needed someone to believe in you.
Kasun shakes his hand.
Anudi smiles.
The three of them stand together beneath the restaurant sign.
On screen: Sometimes love doesn't need money. It just needs someone who believes in your dream.

card.notes: Maintain the same facial appearance, hairstyle, and body type throughout. Wardrobe progresses from simple/poor to more polished as his business succeeds.
card.summary: Young Sri Lankan man building a humble food business into a restaurant.
card.wardrobe: Early: simple plain T‑shirts or casual shirts; dark jeans; simple sandals or sneakers. Later: clean smart‑casual clothing.
card.appearance: Sri Lankan male; medium brown skin; short black hair; light stubble; slim/athletic build; friendly but serious eyes.

card.notes: Maintain the same facial appearance, hairstyle, and body type throughout.
card.summary: Stylish, kind Colombo woman who believes in Kasun’s dream.
card.wardrobe: Modern casual dresses; elegant blouse and trousers; simple jewelry; stylish handbag. Later: slightly more sophisticated outfits.
card.appearance: Sri Lankan woman; medium/light brown skin; long dark black hair; elegant natural makeup; attractive but realistic appearance.

card.summary: Protective, practical Colombo businessman and Anudi’s father.
card.wardrobe: Polo shirts; formal trousers; smart casual shirts. Later: formal shirt and trousers.
card.appearance: Sri Lankan businessman; well-groomed; short black/grey hair; mature appearance.
